entities.name: Bello
entities.description: An adventurous raccoon bard from Bloomburrow whose elemental magic animates trinkets.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Bello pilfered Thran artifacts.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: Plane where Bello took filigree gears.

entities.name: Akoum Skyclave
entities.description: Site of the hedron Bello considers his crowning achievement.

events.summary: Bello travels beyond Bloomburrow, collecting souvenirs from other worlds, including a hedron from the Akoum Skyclave.
events.quote: His crowning achievement, he'll add with a grin, is a hedron plucked from the highest point of the Akoum Skyclave.
